description: TCGA-SKCM skin cutaneous melanoma cohort. One row per tumor sample with clinical, demographic, and selected molecular features. Illustrative asta-format metadata for the autodiscovery_rl example; the real CSV lives on the reward server side only.

datasets.name: tcga_melanoma.csv
datasets.description: One row per melanoma tumor sample with de-identified clinical and molecular annotations.

raw.name: sample_id
raw.description: De-identified unique identifier for the tumor sample.

raw.name: age_at_diagnosis
raw.description: Patient age in years at initial pathologic diagnosis.

raw.name: sex
raw.description: Reported sex of the patient (categorical: female, male).

raw.name: ulceration
raw.description: Presence of tumor ulceration (categorical: present, absent).

raw.name: primary_site
raw.description: Anatomic site of the primary tumor (categorical).

raw.name: braf_mutation
raw.description: BRAF mutation status (categorical: V600E, V600K, wildtype, other).

raw.name: tmb
raw.description: Tumor mutational burden in mutations per megabase.

raw.name: overall_survival_months
raw.description: Overall survival time in months from diagnosis.

raw.name: vital_status
raw.description: Vital status at last follow-up (categorical: alive, dead).
